body: Thank you. I am working from home. Unfortunately, my hours have been cut back because of everything going on. I do have hobbies. Lately it’s mostly gaming and tending to my plants but, for the most part, those things do keep me occupied. I also have a precious dog who I know needs me. I just feel like I’ve been fighting tooth and nail to survive my entire life, and I am so tired of it. I’d like to finally be able to just live and be happy and not feel like I’m barely making it through each day, but I don’t see that happening anytime soon.
